player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

board.current_board: [0]) Oseketa ya velapo yohongele yaco, ko: {board}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Oku imba ku lingiwa lolonduko 0-8 kuenda [macro micro].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ocinyi caco, ci kuete esilivilo liocili.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Ocimunga caco ale okalivulu kaco, ka ci pondola oku ku kuatisa.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: Pole, lomue o kasi vohondo yaco.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Ocimunga comanu vaco, ci ka kuatavo onepa koku yekela olombongo viavo.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Momo omapalo yaco ya siata oku lingiwa lomanu valua.

next_board.any: ombunje yimue yitito calua yi pondola oku kala lomakina yaco.

game_action.played: Player {player_id} played in micro board {macro_idx}, cell {micro_idx} (row {row}, col {col}). Player {opponent_id} must now play in {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Mukwiyu {player_id} usena Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
outcome.draw: Momo omapalo yaco ya kala ndu okuti, ka va kuatele omunu ukuavo o yi yula.
